title: Spikerz QA Final Assessment Report — 5-Day Monitoring Summary

details.title: [Day 2] TIKTOK - TT-02 QA Creator Account: Sandbox account quota exceeded - daily API limit reached
details.description:
Health check on Day 2 detected the following error(s) for TT-02 QA Creator Account (tiktok):

Sandbox account quota exceeded - daily API limit reached
details.reproduction_steps:
1. Navigate to Spikerz QA Dashboard
2. View account TT-02 QA Creator Account
3. Run health check
4. Observe error: Sandbox account quota exceeded - daily API limit reached
details.recommended_action: Wait for quota reset (usually 24 hours). Consider spacing out API requests or reducing check frequency for this platform.

details.title: [Day 3] FACEBOOK - FB-02 QA Business Page: Session expired - Graph API returned error 190; Permissions revoked: Session exp
details.description:
Health check on Day 3 detected the following error(s) for FB-02 QA Business Page (facebook):

Session expired - Graph API returned error 190; Permissions revoked: Session expired
details.reproduction_steps:
1. Navigate to Spikerz QA Dashboard
2. View account FB-02 QA Business Page
3. Run health check
4. Observe error: Session expired - Graph API returned error 190; Permissions revoked: Session expired
details.recommended_action: Re-authenticate the account through the Spikerz UI. Navigate to Settings > Connected Accounts, remove the expired connection, and re-authorize with fresh credentials.

recommendations.recommendation: Implement proactive token refresh logic. Several accounts experienced token expiry during monitoring. Consider adding a background job that refreshes tokens 24 hours before expiry.
Implement request throttling and queuing. Multiple platforms showed rate limit warnings. Stagger health checks across the day rather than running all simultaneously.
Set up real-time alerts (Slack/email) for critical failures. Currently issues are logged but not pushed to the team.
For 100+ accounts, migrate from SQLite to PostgreSQL, add connection pooling, and implement parallel health checks with configurable concurrency limits.
